t: Sound and Sentiment: Birds, Weeping, Poetics, and Song in Kaluli Expression by Steven Feld | Goodreads
s: By studying the form and performance of weeping, poetics, and song in relation to the Kaluli natural and spiritual world, Steven Feld reveals Kaluli sound expressions as embodiments of deeply felt sentiments.
